item.title: Fish and wildlife chair can stay, no license needed to hunt on your own farmland, says AG
item.description: In an about-face, Kentucky Attorney General Russell Coleman’s office says Kentuckians can legally hunt and fish on their own farmland without a license even if their residence is elsewhere in the state.
